description: Frontend workflow guide for SEE API (auth, onboarding, ticketing, RSVPs, pages, notifications, reviews, search, playlists, archive, moderation). Use with SEE.api.web.endpoints.json + SEE.api.payloads.json.

auth.login: Set idToken as Bearer for all calls
GET /v1/auth/me to hydrate profile; capture uid and primaryBusinessId
Capture X-Session-Id response header; send it back on subsequent requests (X-Session-Id) to keep the same session
auth.magicLink: POST /v1/auth/magic-link with {email, redirectUrl?} to request link
User clicks link -> frontend calls POST /v1/auth/magic-link/consume with token to get customToken
Sign into Firebase with customToken, continue login flow
auth.signup: Use returned customToken to sign into Firebase; proceed as login flow
auth.logout: Listen for SignalR event sessionRevoked to drop tokens client-side
onboarding.user: POST /v1/users/{uid}/onboarding with steps + nextStep (track UI state)
onboarding.business: Result: BusinessDetail + primaryBusinessId; use in publisher flows
events.archive.restore: Admin: POST /v1/admin/events/archive-run to move to archive
Admin: POST /v1/admin/archived-events/{id}/restore or DELETE to purge
events.cancel.hide: Publisher cancel SEE events: POST /v1/publisher/events/{id}/cancel (SEE-only guard)
events.create.publisher: Optional: Build page with GET/PUT /v1/publisher/events/{id}/page and preview/publish endpoints
ticketing.checkout: POST /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/checkout/stripe with {quantity, recipientEmail?, recipientPhone?} to create checkout session + payment intent; capture checkoutId, clientSecret
Complete Stripe payment client-side with clientSecret
POST /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/purchase with {quantity?, checkoutId} to issue tickets (requires succeeded intent or free ReadyToIssue)
Listen to SignalR ticketStatusUpdated and ticketDelivery; resend via POST /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/resend
ticketing.refund: POST /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/refund with {reason?, force?} (force requires admin) respects refund cutoff
Receive ticketStatusUpdated and optionally ticketDelivery for any notification about refund
ticketing.verify.checkin: Owner: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/barcode to fetch signed token
rsvp: Listen for rsvpSummaryUpdated via SignalR when on an event page
saved.events: GET /v1/users/{uid}/saved for list; SignalR sessionRevoked should force refetch on logout
event.pages: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/page (public) to render; or previewToken for drafts
reports.moderation: Admin: GET /v1/admin/reports (filters) and GET /v1/admin/events/{id} for flagged event
Admin: PATCH /v1/admin/reports/{id} to update status; DELETE/APPROVE review endpoints for moderation
notifications: REST: GET /v1/users/{uid}/notifications (page, includeRead); PATCH /v1/users/{uid}/notifications/{notificationId} {read:true} to mark read
If realtime received, mark delivered client-side and optionally call PATCH to sync read state
sessions: GET /v1/users/{uid}/sessions to list active sessions (uses stored docs)
POST /v1/auth/logout to end current session; POST /v1/auth/logout-all to end all; sessionRevoked pushes via SignalR
admin.only (reference): Manage playlists, event sources, ingestion, archiving, notifications templates, ticket audit, RSVPs list, etc. Use SEE.api.admin.endpoints.json

realtime.session: Send X-Session-Id header if provided; server returns X-Session-Id
subscribe: Join event groups via query ?eventId=evt1 or hub methods SubscribeEvent/UnsubscribeEvent
Handle client events: ticketStatusUpdated, ticketDelivery, rsvpSummaryUpdated, sessionRevoked, notification
On reconnect: resubscribe to event groups and optionally refetch REST state
realtime.rateLimit: 20 hub calls per 10s per connection; HubException rate_limited if exceeded
